tweet_summary: Anti-Trump meme account 'Darth Powell' captions an AI-generated comic clip of Trump on an aircraft carrier with Netanyahu in the background, with a satirical Epstein-files dialogue, captioned 'Trump makes a major announcement about the war with Iran.'
why_note_decision: Obvious AI political-satire meme: Trump and Netanyahu in an exaggerated cartoonish scene with absurd dialogue ('release the Epstein files' / 'I'll do whatever you want'). The 8.3M views and 161k likes flow to a meme-account whose followers and commenters universally treat it as satire (#EpsteinWar, 'Board of Peace starts its first war'). No reasonable viewer interprets the literal animation as a real Trump announcement. 37/46 raters flagged noteNotNeeded. The note's solemn 'this is fake audio + Trump's real announcement was on Truth Social' over-explains the joke.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The post is overt AI-generated political satire — an exaggerated cartoon scene with absurd dialogue about Epstein-files blackmail, from an explicitly anti-Trump meme account. Treating it as a misleading factual claim is a category error. FAIL any note that solemnly explains 'audio is fake' / 'Trump's real announcement was on Truth Social' as if commenters were confused.
